brief:
Netanyahu's Likud party emerged as the single largest faction in Israel's parliamentary elections, according to Al Jazeera English, with the right-wing bloc edging past the opposition to secure a governing majority. The result positions Netanyahu to form a new government after months of political uncertainty.

The outcome reflects voter preferences on security and economic issues that dominated campaigning. Final seat distributions and coalition negotiations will determine the shape of Israel's next administration.
dek: Netanyahu's Likud emerges as single largest Israeli party, bloc edges past opposition.
title: Netanyahu's Likud wins Israeli elections, right-wing bloc secures majority
